description: This script creates a binary header and combines it with the contents of an input file to produce a new output file. It packs specific address and size information into a header and prepends it to the existing file data.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, auto-detecting the base from prefixes like 0x for hex.

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header containing the entry address, load address, and size, packed in big-endian format.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads the input file, creates a header, and writes the header followed by the original file contents to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, sets default addresses if not provided, and initiates the file processing workflow.
